description: This PHP source file defines the PayGradeAPI class, which implements a RESTful API endpoint for managing PayGrade entities. It provides methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting pay grade records, including validation rules and JSON documentation annotations for API documentation. The class uses traits and references to external models, data transfer objects, and services related to pay grade management.
